findings.evidenceJa: やってきた相手が誰なのか
findings.governingReading: Without turning, Shirou knows the identity of the person who has just approached.
findings.explanation: The English keeps recognition but drops the approach and arrival relation.

findings.highlight: she wanted me to hear her coming
findings.evidenceJa: 俺に気を遣ったからだろう
findings.governingReading: He supposes Rider deliberately made audible footsteps out of consideration for his state.
findings.explanation: The English preserves intention but removes the considerate motive.

findings.evidenceJa: 間の抜けたヤツ
findings.governingReading: Shirou laughs at himself as absurdly absentminded for noticing Rider’s height so late.
findings.explanation: The English changes comic obtuseness into generic slowness.

findings.evidenceJa: 声はわずかに怒っているようだった
findings.governingReading: Her voice only seems slightly angry, and Shirou explicitly allows that it may be his imagination.
findings.explanation: The English drops the slight degree inside the already qualified impression.

findings.evidenceJa: 貴方たちを運んだのは私です
findings.governingReading: Rider confirms that she transported Shirou and the others.
findings.explanation: The English confirms her agency but omits the transported group.

findings.evidenceJa: ライダーは淡々と語る
findings.governingReading: Rider speaks in an even, dispassionate manner that Shirou initially reads as emotionally cold.
findings.explanation: “Plainly” suggests clarity or directness and loses her affect.

findings.highlight: If you have a question, please ask it.
findings.evidenceJa: 訊ね事があるのなら先にどうぞ
findings.governingReading: Rider invites Shirou to ask his question first, before her own.
findings.explanation: The English omits the turn-order concession.

findings.highlight: using her life to stay in this world
findings.evidenceJa: その肉体を再契約までの糧として
findings.governingReading: In Shirou’s feared scenario, Rider would use Sakura’s body as sustenance until another contract.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes the concrete body and its role as nourishment into “life.”

findings.evidenceJa: ライダー本人の意思
findings.governingReading: Shirou wants to hear Rider’s own will directly.
findings.explanation: The English replaces volition and chosen allegiance with feelings.

findings.highlight: for me to have such an emotion
findings.evidenceJa: 私が感情を持つ事が
findings.governingReading: Rider asks whether Shirou is surprised that she possesses emotions at all.
findings.explanation: The English narrows a general capacity for feeling to one unspecified particular emotion.

findings.evidenceJa: その魂の在り方が近いから
findings.governingReading: Rider says Saber and Shirou were drawn together because the form or nature of their souls is close.
findings.explanation: The English retains similarity while deleting its soul-level basis.

findings.evidenceJa: すごく淑やかな性格
findings.governingReading: Shirou revises his assumption toward Rider having a notably demure, graceful disposition.
findings.explanation: “Gentle” loses the quiet refinement of his new impression.

findings.highlight: since she was adopted to the Makiri family
findings.evidenceJa: マキリの家に貰われてから
findings.governingReading: Rider asks about the suffering Sakura endured since being taken or adopted into the Makiri household.
findings.explanation: “Adopted to” is malformed English.

findings.highlight: I don’t think I can say anything about it, nor should I mention it
findings.evidenceJa: それを口にする事も、しちゃいけない
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he must not put a claim of understanding into words.
findings.explanation: The English makes him refuse to discuss or mention the abuse at all.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺だって魔術師の端くれで
findings.governingReading: Shirou calls himself only a marginal or lesser practitioner of magecraft while claiming enough knowledge to imagine Zouken’s acts.
findings.explanation: The English removes his self-limiting stance.

findings.highlight: should not easily mention that I “understand”
findings.evidenceJa: 容易く“解る”なんて口にしてはいけない
findings.governingReading: He must not glibly or casually say that he understands Sakura’s suffering.
findings.explanation: The English attaches ease to mentioning rather than the moral lightness of claiming understanding.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜と感覚を共有する
findings.governingReading: Rider shares Sakura’s sensations through their Master-Servant connection.
findings.explanation: The English changes shared sensation into emotional agreement or empathy.

findings.evidenceJa: 目隠し越しに
findings.governingReading: Rider confronts him from behind her single blindfold.
findings.explanation: The English makes the blindfold plural.

findings.highlight: what I’m planning to do with my body
findings.evidenceJa: そんな体でこれ以上何をするつもりだ
findings.governingReading: Rider presses him on what more he intends to do in such a damaged condition.
findings.explanation: The English removes “further” and turns bodily condition into the object of a plan.

findings.evidenceJa: 動かない左腕
findings.governingReading: Shirou grips his immobile left arm.
findings.explanation: The English again weakens inability to move into stiffness.

findings.highlight: If I can fight with one arm, I should.
findings.evidenceJa: どんな身体だろうとまだ戦えるのなら、戦わないといけない
findings.governingReading: Whatever state his body is in, he believes he must fight if he can still fight.
findings.explanation: The English adds a separate one-arm proposition before translating the source thought.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜の為だけに戦う
findings.governingReading: He has chosen to fight solely for Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English omits the exclusivity that defines his new commitment.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺は俯いたまま答えがない
findings.governingReading: Shirou remains with his head lowered and cannot answer.
findings.explanation: The English deletes his sustained physical posture.

findings.evidenceJa: 心の何処かで気付いてしまった
findings.governingReading: Some part of him has already, unwillingly, grasped what Rider’s condition points toward.
findings.explanation: The English turns partial, unwelcome awareness into an unqualified present realization.

findings.highlight: You should be prepared when that time comes
findings.evidenceJa: その時までに覚悟を決めておく
findings.governingReading: Rider tells him to settle his resolve by the time the answer arrives.
findings.explanation: The English shifts the deadline from before that moment to when it occurs.

findings.highlight: as if melting into the night
findings.evidenceJa: 闇に溶ける様に
findings.governingReading: Rider departs as though dissolving into darkness.
findings.explanation: The English replaces abstract darkness with the more ordinary night.

findings.evidenceJa: 未だ正体の掴めない黒い影
findings.governingReading: The shadow’s identity remains impossible for Shirou to grasp.
findings.explanation: The English retains mystery but deletes the continuing failure to identify it.

findings.highlight: it can make any wish come true
findings.evidenceJa: 他のどんな望みも叶う
findings.governingReading: The Grail could grant any other wish, in contrast with the single wish of Sakura’s happiness.
findings.explanation: The English deletes “other,” weakening the exception structure.

findings.highlight: my wish to provide Sakura happiness
findings.evidenceJa: 桜を幸福にするという願い
findings.governingReading: His wish is to make Sakura happy.
findings.explanation: “Provide Sakura happiness” is non-English idiom that obscures a central commitment.
